entities.summary: Sandıklı is a town of Afyonkarahisar Province in the Aegean region of Turkey. It is the seat of Sandıklı District. Its population is 54,851 (2024). Adnan Öztaş was elected from the AK Party in the 2024 Turkish Local Elections.
